caveats: Start skins differ; direct thermal comparisons are conditional on those recorded starts.
Picker accuracy NOT EVALUATED; latency, execution and cadence misses are not accuracy.
Single measured runs at one ambient temperature; no repeatability or ambient sweep. Ambient is not recorded in the P23 JSON.
Fixed had a short rest: observed monotonic gap below the owner >=30 min rule.
Monotonic rest gaps use increasing device timestamps; no boot ID is recorded, so cross-invocation clock continuity is UNVERIFIED.
Phase-1 fixed validity labels are retained, including NOT COMPARABLE — START TEMP and rehearsals.

methods.active_minutes: Cumulative active-phase wall time, including camera start and boundary waits; pauses excluded.
methods.caps: Later sample owns preceding interval; no tail credit, identical to power_map.capped_by_policy.
methods.m2: Inference-only duration; calls.csv also keeps full wall duration.
methods.p95: Nearest rank ceil(.95*n); median is statistics.median.
methods.power: power.weighted on raw current_now receipt samples: clipped trapezoids, <=1.5 s gaps, no extrapolation.
methods.scope: P23 measured origin through end; idle, gate and cleanup excluded from mode totals. Phase1 comparison excludes warmup.
methods.skin_crossings: First recorded skin receipt >= threshold; no interpolation.
